description: This is a shell script for rehashing SSL certificate and CRL files in a specified directory. It scans files for specific headers to determine their type, generates fingerprints and hashes using OpenSSL, and creates symbolic links for certificate management.

methods.name: check_file
methods.description: Determines if a file contains a certificate or CRL header by pattern matching specific PEM headers.

methods.name: fingerprint
methods.description: Generates a fingerprint of a certificate or CRL file using OpenSSL.

methods.name: link_hash
methods.description: Creates symbolic links for certificate/CRL files based on their hash to facilitate easy referencing and validation.

methods.name: hash_dir
methods.description: Processes a directory to rehash and link certificate and CRL files.
